tools.name: list_index_editions
tools.description: Every published edition of Third Hemisphere's AI Authority Index, with its markets (sections), publication date, DOI where recorded, and links to its page, results, and open data. Read-only. Every result carries its citation and link.

tools.name: get_edition_results
tools.description: The published results of one AI Authority Index edition section: each company's Star Chart cell, CRISP score where it has one, the five factor readings the edition prints, and how many AI answers named it. Read-only. Every result carries its citation and link.

tools.name: get_company_authority_score
tools.description: A company's published CRISP score and AI visibility reading in each market the AI Authority Index measures it in, with the month measured and its Standing Report link. Accepts a company name or slug. Read-only. Every result carries its citation and link.

tools.name: get_company_score_history
tools.description: Every dated reading the AI Authority Index has published for a company, oldest first: its rows in each edition and each market's Standing Report. Read-only. Every result carries its citation and link.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find companies with a Standing Report in Third Hemisphere's AI Authority Index by name. Read-only. Every result carries its citation and link.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Every market the AI Authority Index measures, with how many Standing Reports it has and when it was last measured. Read-only. Every result carries its citation and link.

tools.name: get_market_standing
tools.description: The companies in one market with a Standing Report, most named in AI answers first. Read-only. Every result carries its citation and link.

description: The AI Authority Blueprints sent to the address this key belongs to. Needs a key on a plan that includes DIY Blueprint tools. DIY Blueprint tool: needs a key whose plan includes them (https://thirdhemisphere.agency/ai-authority-index/data#blueprint-diy).

description.name: get_my_blueprint_plan
description.description: Your Blueprint's ranked strategy plays and 90-day moves, each with an item_id, what to do, when, and how the next Blueprint measures it, with the status recorded for each. DIY Blueprint tool: needs a key whose plan includes them (https://thirdhemisphere.agency/ai-authority-index/data#blueprint-diy).

description.name: get_blueprint_item_evidence
description.description: The data behind one play or move: your own numbers from the Blueprint, why it works and the research it rests on, and what not to do. DIY Blueprint tool: needs a key whose plan includes them (https://thirdhemisphere.agency/ai-authority-index/data#blueprint-diy).

description.name: update_blueprint_progress
description.description: Record where a play or move stands: not_started, in_progress, done, skipped, with an optional note of what was done. DIY Blueprint tool: needs a key whose plan includes them (https://thirdhemisphere.agency/ai-authority-index/data#blueprint-diy).

description.name: get_blueprint_progress
description.description: Where every play and move in your Blueprint stands, with the counts done, in progress, and not started. DIY Blueprint tool: needs a key whose plan includes them (https://thirdhemisphere.agency/ai-authority-index/data#blueprint-diy).
